facts.fact: 西德妮把几把铁锹扛到肩上，从老旧半陷的坟之间穿过去。
facts.anchor: hoisted the shovels on her shoulder

facts.fact: 八年前的那一夜，他们第一次把维克多从土里挖出来。
facts.anchor: they dug Victor up the first time

facts.fact: 这一夜他们来到墓地，是要把他放回去。
facts.anchor: now they were here to put him back

facts.fact: 米奇分成两个身体，一起分担重量。
facts.anchor: two of him, in fact, sharing the weight

facts.fact: 维克多的遗体裹在米奇的黑外套里。
facts.anchor: Victor’s body wrapped in his black coat

facts.fact: 挖坟时是她一个、米奇四个一起动手。
facts.anchor: one of her and four of him

facts.fact: 他们一路挖到那只空的木箱。
facts.anchor: down to the empty wooden box

facts.fact: 她最后明白，是时候放他走了。
facts.anchor: it was time to let him go
